cards.title: while loops
cards.body: A `while` loop repeats as long as its condition is true. Something inside must change, or it never stops.

cards.title: break

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The loop stops when `n > 0` is first false, at 0. The `console.log` is after the loop, so it runs once.

exercise.prompt: Read N and count down from N to 1, one number per line, then print `Liftoff!`. Use a `while` loop.
